title: God Candle
description: Kill bears to charge a hype meter. When it's full, a giant green candle slams down and liquidates every bear on screen.

title: Airdrop crates
description: Every minute a crate parachutes onto the chart. Grab it for a magnet, a shield or ten seconds of money printer.

title: The bear who went long
description: A third character: a bear who flipped bullish. Slow and tanky, he starts with a paw swipe that knocks bears back.
